convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for 'madelta_inc' indicator and has a non-standard cubic amplifier signal transformation that isn't a simple crossover pattern. Signal logic relies on a custom threshold discriminator with dynamic hi/lo channels.

derived_values.name: Cubic amplifier transfer px
derived_values.used_by: signal for threshold discriminator and trade direction

other_exits: Reverse signal closes opposite position then opens new position in signal direction

position_sizing.conditional_logic: lots = min(15.0, round(AccountFreeMargin/2000, 1 decimal)); on reversal, uses existing position volume

custom_logic_notes: The EA uses a cubic amplifier transfer function: px = pow(m*(mf-ms),3) which heavily exaggerates the MA difference. A dynamic threshold discriminator tracks hi/lo with a channel width of Delta*Point. When px exceeds hi, a long signal fires and the lo threshold resets to hi-d. When px falls below lo, a short signal fires and the hi threshold resets to lo+d. This creates a hysteresis band preventing whipsaws. The flg variable ensures hi/lo are initialized to 0 on the first tick only. The iCustom call to 'madelta_inc' is made but its buffer is never read in OnTick - it appears to be for visual/chart display only.
external_dependencies: madelta_inc (custom indicator, used in iCustom but buffer not consumed by EA logic)
python_conversion_notes: The cubic amplifier and dynamic hi/lo threshold discriminator must be implemented as a stateful signal generator. The hi/lo state persists across ticks and must be maintained in the strategy object. The Delta parameter (195) is multiplied by 0.00001 which assumes 5-digit pricing; this must be adapted to use _Point equivalent in Python for digit-portability. Position sizing uses AccountFreeMargin/2000 which maps to free_margin/2000 in backtesting frameworks. Note the iCustom indicator is only for display and can be omitted from Python conversion. Signal reversal logic: when already in a SELL and trade==1, close sell and buy same volume; when already in a BUY and trade==-1, close buy and sell same volume. When flat, open with calculated lot size.
